notes.title: 🌊 Trash Sailors is out on Steam now! 🌊
notes.content:
[h1]🌊All hands on deck, sailors!🌊[/h1]

[h1]Trash Sailors is out on Steam now![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XpFj8O6.gif[/img]

[h3]⚓️ Summon your team and get on board! ⚓️[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

In a post-apocalyptic world flooded by a trash tsunami, you are the captain of a small raft floating above the “Trashy” waves. Sail your raft along with your crewmates to the deserted glaciers, mysterious swamps and fallen cities and fight ferocious enemies and marine creatures along your way. The ultimate goal is to sail as far as you can and collect trash to keep your team and the raft afloat. After all, the captain goes down with the ship!

[h3]🔴Watch the launch trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=zKtK3EUAc5k;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Before you get underway, take a quick look at what you might encounter during your voyage! 👇[/h3]

[quote][b][h3]- Fun(or chaotic) cooperative trash hunting adventure[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/98Pbr6o.gif[/img]

The game is available in [b]local and online co-op for you and your friends with a maximum of 4 players.[/b] Have some chaotic fun on your couch for this holiday season!

Survive maelstroms by assigning mariners different jobs: every ship needs a captain, just like it also needs fuel. Create the trashiest sailing team in history, fight with monsters and trash your friendship![/quote]

[quote][b][h3]- Delicate hand-drawn trash piracy[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pd7ceTI.gif[/img]

Keep your raft afloat in this magnificent world depicted by fine hand-drawn art! From the trashy waves, the gigantic sea monsters to all elements in the environment, everything is hand-drawn! [/quote]

[quote][b][h3]- More than 20 levels with different seascape sceneries[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PldX7ln.gif[/img]

Sail to the hottest jungles or the iciest waters in Trash Sailors! Work your way up to enjoy different seascapes while casting a wide net to fish discarded items and treasure chests filled with golden screws! [/quote]

[quote][b][h3]- A roster of characters, enemies, raft customization options and equipment[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V3hXyhA.gif[/img]

There are [b]4[/b] main characters, around [b]20[/b] types of gruesome marine creatures and enemies, [b]40[/b] types of trash items, and almost [b]45[/b] different customization options for the raft! Choose your favorite characters and prepare for an epic marine battle filled with unexpected thrills. [/quote]

[quote][b][h3]- Flexible Accessibility Settings that allow you to adjust the difficulty levels[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g9d1YjF.gif[/img]

There are [b]7[/b] different options in the Accessibility Settings and [b]3[/b] presets available for you to flexibly adjust the difficulties to get rid of unwanted threats and enjoy the cool ocean breeze. 

In the meantime, the game automatically changes the difficulty level based on real-time situations on the raft. With different numbers of players on board, your HP levels, enemy numbers and engine fuel consumption speed, you can fine tune your experience to your liking! [/quote]

[h1]AND MUCH MORE for you to discover by yourself![/h1]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]We are excited to welcome pirates everywhere into the trashy waves! [/h3]

[h3]In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages to get tips, latest news and updates![/h3]

notes.title: Captain's Log#2: Greet the Trashy sea monsters!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings brave sailors,[/h1]

Don’t get too relaxed if you have committed the tips we offered in the previous Captain’s Log about [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1132030/view/3112545749373946701]enemies you may encounter at sea[/url][/b] to memory. There are far more life-threatening occasions in this Trashy ocean than you can imagine!

Before we dive into today’s Captain Log, let’s check again to make sure everyone has [b]WISHLISTed[/b] Trash Sailors, shall we?

[h1]Hang tight, it is coming to Steam in less than three weeks! (Launch date: December 16th)[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[h3]While some of the enemies fight you for the invaluable trash resources, there are also some situations where you can be attacked just because you are entering certain parts of the map![/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]With that being said, let’s take a look at some of the SEA CREATURES that may or may not swallow your entire raft![/h3]

[quote][h1][b]Crocodile [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NJB8SEC.gif[/img]

These green monsters may look familiar to you and they are travelling to inhabit the ocean now! Use your paddle to drive them away before their gigantic jaws wreck your raft with just a few bites!

[h3]Tip: [/h3]
Collect as much trash as you can when you are entering the crocodiles’ realm, it is highly inevitable to suffer from a few bites but you can still save the day by repairing your raft quickly with resources![/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Roboshark [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/86aQ7zM.gif[/img]

While we are talking about giant and razor-sharp teeth, it would not make sense to leave these blue-grey fins behind. The Robosharks were made to sink your raft and what makes things worse is that they normally come in legions too.

[h3]Tip: [/h3]
Turn on the light located at the top of your foremast if you encounter these big babies in the dark. As giant as they are, light is still one of the most terrifying things that can drive them away. [/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Walrus [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hC76EGx.gif[/img]

Walruses may look friendly to you for a second when they greet you with a lazy gesture on the floating ice. However, once they become too cuddly and jump on board, you face the threats of a sinking raft. At the end of the day, even if they do nothing to you, their heavy body weights can cause your raft to lose balance and get swallowed by the trashy waves.

[h3]Tip: [/h3]
Have one or two of your crew members jump on the other side when a Walrus decides to get comfortable on one side of your raft. It will help you greatly in balancing your raft.[/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Spider [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ec4IfmI.gif[/img]

Things rot quickly at sea with the moisty and salty air. Thus it would not be strange to have spiders on board, eh? The eight-legged menace crawls down from the top of your foremast in the dark environment and can knock you down easily with a few hits.

[h3]Tip: [/h3]
Similar to the Robosharks, the spiders are afraid of light so turn on the lightbulb and they will disappear.[/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Mermaid [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l16KKGq.gif[/img]

Just like the vast oceans, everything that appears to be too fascinating may have a violent nature that can drag you down. It was written in the old tales that no sailor can resist the charm of a singing mermaid. Don’t get too intoxicated, that’s all we ask.[/quote]

[quote][h1][b]??? [/b][/h1]

[b]As you write your legend across more waters, things can get really serious and you will encounter creatures that are much more gruesome than the ones you have defeated. Find out the Boss yourself and prove your bravery and intelligence, sailors! We look forward to your epic performances![/b][/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]The list still goes on but it’d be more fun for you to discover them yourself. Show off your battles and chat with other sailors in our community channels, we welcome all here![/h3]

notes.title: Captain's Log#1: Enemies You Will Encounter At Sea
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings brave sailors,[/h1]

The waves can swallow everything and the dangers at sea lurk everywhere. Before you get underway, we’d like to prepare you for a series of situations/enemies you might encounter on your Trashy cruise. After all, the captain goes down with the ship and I am sure you would not want that to happen.

Before we unfold this Captain’s Log, let’s check the engine again and make sure everyone has [b]WISHLIST[/b]ed the game. 

[h3]Trash Sailors is coming to Steam on December 16th and you have less than a month to get yourself ready for the bumpy yet exhilarating journey![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

Without further ado, let’s get to know some of the not so friendly encounters you may have on the waters!

[quote][h1][b]Tireman: [/b][/h1]
Batten down the hatches for these grumpy-looking attackers! Apparently these guys don't fancy visitors in their territory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DoxqND1.gif[/img]

As you can tell from their appearances, they might have been victims of the great trash tsunami. However, there is no empathy needed when it comes to brutal battles for the invaluable trash resources!

[h3]Tip:[/h3]  
Different from some of the other enemies, they are unarmed and normally just use their bare fists to attack. Use your paddle to knock them down! [/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Robber: [/b][/h1]

[b]Fair warning:[/b] these Robbers can easily drive sailors up the pole. They rampage across the waters in large groups and make waves. Spend some time at sea and improve, landlubbers suffer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T49CdF3.gif[/img]

[h3]Tip:[/h3] 
They normally emerge from the waves with their submarines and come in a big crowd. Watch out even though it looks like a peaceful body of sea at first, things can turn serious quickly. [/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Surfer: [/b][/h1]

Surfers don't just ride the waves here, they make waves. Beware of the sharp daggers they always hold tightly in hand. Don’t freak out if you get hurt and knocked out, call for rescue from your fellow crew member and you can confront them again!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fRJjMHC.gif[/img]

[h3]Tip: [/h3]
Let the waves wash away the raft deck, the surfers, as indicated by their name, will get carried away by the waves too. [/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Rabbit: [/b][/h1]

Don’t be fooled by these little cuties surfing in the fine tea cups. They are as ferocious as the other enemies and definitely not the one to pet. At the end of the day, you can probably tell from the pirate’s tricorn hat on their heads that they are not some friendly figures too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ry8bHdq.gif[/img]

[h3]Tip:[/h3] 
There are two types of different Rabbits so be vigilant and treat them differently 
[b]Stealers [/b]- They try to steal resources as soon as land on the raft
[b]Steermans[/b] - They try to take control over the raft by steering it left or right[/quote]

[quote][h1][b]Tribe: [/b][/h1]

They have the best costume as camouflage and rather aggressive dance numbers. If you see sea fortresses on the horizon, you are slowly invading their realm and you cannot blame them for starting the battle.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CEbkcNT.gif[/img]

[h3]Tip: [/h3]

They normally observe from their fortresses in silence first and then hop on to your raft when you are a short distance away. That gives you the chance to utilize the cannons equipped on your raft to aim at them before they even start the attack. [/quote]

[hr][/hr]

Let’s wrap it up here before you get too anxious before boarding the raft. The enemies are ferocious but there are various ways to defeat them and secure a peaceful cruise.

[h3]Stay tuned for more episodes on the Captain’s Logs that are coming in the following weeks and join our community spaces to chat with fellow sailors![/h3]

notes.title: Trash Sailors is coming to Steam on December 16th!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello captains![/h3]

[h3]Weigh anchor, check the fuel tank and warm up the engine. We will be ready to go underway soon! [/h3]

[h1]Trash Sailors is coming to Steam with co-op up to 4 players on December 16, 2021![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a5VgFmH.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[b][h3] 🔴 Watch the Release Date Announcement Trailer:[/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=9UGzpzcqegU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]If you are already excited about joining the nautical mayhem, get on board by WISHLISTing now! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[hr][/hr]

[b]Let’s take some time to walk through the game![/b]

In a world flooded by a trash tsunami, you are trapped in the middle of the ocean with a small raft. Trash is your primary resource and the most valuable thing in this world. You can recycle it into fuel, raft spare parts, and even weapons. Brace yourself for swamp crocodiles, toxic sharks, arctic pirates, and much, much more!

[h1]Main Features:[/h1]

[h3]- Online and local 4-player coop[/h3]

Band together with up to three other shipmates via online and local multiplayer to thread the filthy waters. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BAwN2vx.gif[/img]

[h3]- Hand-drawn Trash Piracy[/h3]

From the smelly swamps and sunken cities to arctic pirates and gruesome marine creatures, everything is depicted with delicate hand-drawn arts in this world!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/moSiviD.gif[/img]

[h3]- Dozens of seas for treasure hunting and monster feeding![/h3]

Sail to the hottest jungles or the iciest waters in Trash Sailors! Work your way up to enjoy different seascapes while casting a wide net to fish discarded items and treasure chests filled with golden screws!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gxQitKD.gif[/img]

[h3]- Uncivilized battles for the last piece of trash[/h3]

Now the most valuable currency in the world, rubbish works as fuel and materials to repair not-so-perfect parts of the vessel. Fight pirates, tribe members, robosharks, a Trashkraken, and other mucky monsters while keeping the raft together and surviving till the end of each level. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z5ADjGF.gif[/img]

[h3]- Literally an ocean of trash to sail on with your friends![/h3]

Survive maelstroms by assigning mariners different jobs: every ship needs a captain, just like it also needs fuel. [b]Create the trashiest sailing team in history, fight with monsters and trash your friendship![/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]We are excited to welcome pirates everywhere into our waggish world! As usual, please don’t forget to WISHLIST![/h3]

notes.title: Play Trash Sailors' Demo during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]🌊⚓️Ahoy sailors![/h1]

Smell that salty breeze in the air? It’s that time of the year again! 

[b]The Steam Next Fest starts today, and you are invited to embark on an exhilarating journey through the “Trashy” ocean. Try out the newest DEMO of Trash Sailors, and let us know what you think![/b]

[h3]Watch the latest demo trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=RAGUc_B98xw;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

[h3] We know you are pretty curious of the game so here is a quick walkthrough of how it works![/h3]

In a world flooded by a trash tsunami, you are trapped in the middle of the ocean with a small raft. Your only chance of survival is the garbage floating in the waves around you.

[h3]Collect trash, defeat enemies and survive.[/h3]

[h3][b]- 🗑️Gather trash along the way[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z6WQO6n.gif[/img]

Observe and locate the suitable type of trash according to the monitor, use a grappling hook to reach out to the floating targets (or, invaluable resources as we see them in the Trash Sailors world) and gather them on board. 

This is the most basic task that can support you through fierce waves and sly enemies. So keep your eyes wide open and practice casting the hook! It takes a lot of training for a sailor to become a real captain!

[h3][b]- ⛽️Use the trash as fuel to start the engine, repair the raft or take down the enemies![/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PDQApt4.gif[/img]

Once you have collected some resources, there are tons of next steps that you can take. Fire up the tank engine to get the journey started quickly or take some time to repair the raft that sea creatures or other enemies have damaged, it is all up to you!

If you’d like to clear out some obstacles ahead or burn the enemies’ forts to the ground, you can even shoot the garbage out! Aim at the target and fire out the trash. You will not be disappointed.

[h3][b]- ☸️ Steer the raft and navigate through the waves.[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0JCFHGF.gif[/img]

Steer your raft by yourself, in a pair, or as a full team to make sure you don’t rewrite the story of Titanic! Avoid the floating icebergs, coral reefs and SHARKs. A quick turn of the wheel can save you lots of trouble.

[h3][b]- 🗺️Travel across different maps to gather trash.[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zp9GBiv.gif[/img]

From the hottest jungles to the icy Arctic, your raft can take you around the whole globe to witness stunningly beautiful seascapes. Gather trash as you travel and go as far as you can!

[h3][b]- 💀Most importantly, try not to SINK![/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Aen439A.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tKujpy3.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ysYz1j.gif[/img]

The further you have sailed, the more threats will emerge on your way. Battle with the lurking crocodiles/sharks/walruses/crows(this list does not end here😏), avoid the vomiting pipes, shoot the pirates and tribesmen down and keep an eye out for the dangerous shooting air-balloons above. 

Every day on board is more than exciting and busy, so always make sure you’ve packed enough trash before you bump into one of the many life-threatening situations!

[h3][b]- Accessibility Settings![/b][/h3]
Need a chill ride to relax after a long day? Flexibly adjust the Accessibility Settings to get rid of unwanted threats and enjoy the cool ocean breeze. Customize the accessibility to an extent that you are most comfortable with and define your own nautical legend!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qm9Lrmg.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]About the Multiplayer Mode:[/h3]

We are currently at the final stage of improving and testing the game. One of the main focuses is to improve the online multiplayer experience. Unfortunately, the current demo has not been able to support the online multiplayer mode just yet, and we are working our best to bring you good news on that and the official release date soon!

For now, we suggest you try out [b]Remote Play Together[/b] on Steam and play with friends in that way!

[b]How it works:[/b]
1. Launch your demo
2. From your Friends List, invite your friends to play together
3. They accept and… Boom! You are playing together!

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Read more about Steam Remote Play.[/url] [/h3]

[hr][/hr]

Ready to dive into the new demo now? Visit our store page and update now! Don't forget to WISHLIST so you can get all future release news and updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132030/Trash_Sailors/

[h3]In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages![/h3]

[i][list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/X2GvEfp]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/trashsailors/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/TrashSailors]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/trashsailors/]Instagram[/url]
[/list][/i]

That's all for today, see you in the game and stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Ride the waves of garbage with Trash Sailors!
notes.content:
Ahoy, lads!

Have you ever felt like today sea sailing is just too easy? The winds are not smelly enough? Your ship isn’t getting destroyed by debris? Noone’s drowning in the garbage?

Well even if you don’t — this became a reality after the trash tsunami hit the world. And Trash Sailors is here to navigate you through this dumpster fire of an ocean to a cleaner future!

In Trash Sailors, you’ll be able to
[list]
[*] Make the splash together with up to 4 bums — in local or online co-op.
[*] Explore dozens of seas in search of trash-sure
[*] Fight pirates and mutants for the last piece of garbage.
[*] Destroy your friendship over some complete rubbish.
[/list]


We’re happy to announce that Trash Sailors will be published by tinyBuild. Learn more in our trailer:
[previewyoutube=Ut5iggDgEog;full][/previewyoutube]
